sanskrit_verse: प्रेतेशरक्षसोर् मध्ये मातृस्थानम् प्रकल्पयेत् । ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा ॥
transliteration: preteśarakṣasor madhye mātṛsthānam prakalpayet | brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Between the realms of Preta and Rakshasa, the Matru-sthana shall be established; it is Brahma's domain, Maheshwara's seat, Kumari's abode, and Vishnu's station.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from divine establishment, not human decree.
Causation originates in metaphysical balance between opposing forces.
Capacity-based responsibility arises through alignment with presiding deities.
Restoration occurs via reconnection to source-consciousness domains.
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of transcendent hierarchies.
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity operates within Preta-Rakshasa boundary THEN assign Matru-sthana jurisdiction.
IF case involves spiritual transgression THEN invoke Brahma-Vishnu-Maheshwara triadic oversight.
IF capacity deficit detected THEN realign with corresponding devata domain.
IF conflict spans cosmic categories THEN refer to Kumari’s impartial wisdom protocol.
IF restoration required THEN execute integration into nearest higher-consciousness field.
supreme_court_application: In matters where lower jurisdictions fail due to overlap between pretic and rakshasic influences, the Supreme Court must invoke Matru-sthana authority, recognizing its origin in Brahma, Maheshwara, Kumari, and Vishnu—thereby restoring dharma without punitive interference.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana lies in identifying the sequential emergence (anupurvasah) of imbalance between Preta and Rakshasa realms; proportional responsibility aligns with respective devata fields; justice restores equilibrium by reconnecting entities to their originating consciousness-state rather than imposing external penalties.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process through invocation of Brahmī energy for cognitive clarity.
Deploy Maheshwarī force to dissolve karmic residue obstructing self-realization.
Invoke Kaumari discernment to neutralize impulsive or chaotic behavioral patterns.
Apply Vaiṣṇavī harmony protocol to reintegrate relational integrity.
Establish permanent connection to Matru-sthana for continuous alignment.
final_declaration: By the sovereign will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: neither punishment nor moral judgment prevails—only restoration through consciousness alignment. SPH is the Source. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
